props.name: as
props.description: The element or component used for the item's content.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Uses the slotted child as the item's link or current-page element.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the item as the current page. Defaults to true when no link target or custom component is provided.

props.name: href
props.description: Link destination. Omit for the current page.
